title: Two left
html_source:
We’ve had Stephen on the strand , on his own, not wanting to return to the Martello. Leopold’s had the close exclusion of the funeral, the physical buffeting in the press works and the conversation in Davy Byrne’s. Now Stephen is about to further the ‘outsider’ theme with a debate on art with AE and John Eglington, poet and critic respectively. It’s not since the last lines of Portrait of the artist as a young man that we’ve heard significantly from Stephen.

Using the simple mechanics of the time of day and two characters, this theme is extended in the National Library. The armchair nationalists have been explored at the press works and now Stephen will forge in the smithy of my soul the uncreated conscience of my race by having a crack at the literati.
